Commentary.Commentary: Lungi Ngidi and Andile Phehlukwayo were the pick of the bowlers, taking 3 apiece. Tabraiz Shamsi didn't provide a breakthrough but he was frugal. Having said all that, it won't be a walk in the park for the Proteas. In the last game, they initially stuttered against the spin test but overcame it later on. Though it is a below par total, Sri Lanka have some wily spinners in the ranks capable of defending it. It promises to be an exciting chase. Join us shortly after the break.

The wicket-keeper batsman missed out on his ton though but the Lankan skipper continued to hold one end up. He scored an important fifty but kept losing partners at the other end. As a result, he couldn't tee off and kept on rotating the strike. Credit to the South African bowlers too as they bowled consistent lines and lengths to keep the pressure on the opposition. They only conceded 51 in the last 10 overs, taking the fizz out of the hosts' innings and denying them any kind of momentum.

A disciplined bowling performance from South Africa has allowed them to restrict Sri Lanka under 250. They once again threatened to trigger a collapse in Powerplay 1 but couldn't as this time Niroshan Dickwella put his hand up. He along with Kusal Perera and Angelo Mathews, stitched useful partnerships, giving some sort of a foundation to his side.
No, he can't! A very full ball outside off, Mathews drags his heave towards long on for a single. Only 3 from the final over. SRI LANKA FINISH ON 244/8.
Jayasuriya makes room and Rabada follows him with a short one. Played awkwardly towards point to rotate strike. Right then, can Mathews clear the boundary on the last ball?

Short ball down leg, swiped away to find leg for a single. Interesting ploy. Now he crosses, handing the strike to a number 10 batsman who is also a debutant. Clearly out of sorts, the Lankan skipper.
Third dot in a row! Worth in gold at this moment. Length ball around off, Mathews swings at it but toe ends it towards mid off.
Another one in the blockhole outside off, squeezed out past the point fielder. Mathews decides against the run. Don't know whether it is the right tactic.
A brilliant yorker on middle, Mathews jams it out towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! Innovative! Fullish ball around off, Jayasuriya shuffles across and paddle scoops it over short fine leg. Duminy hares across to his right and dives full length but is unlucky not to stop it. A great effort nonetheless.
Shortish ball on middle and leg, fended from the crease.
Guided down to fine leg by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Mathews swipes the length ball to wide long on for a couple.

Safe! Back of a length ball, angling in. Jayasuriya tries to work it away but is hit near the knee roll. Only de Kock is appealing as the umpire remains unmoved. Faf has a look at the keeper and takes the review. There is no bat involved. The Hawk Eye now shows that it is just clipping the top of the stumps. The on-field call stays.
Faf du Plessis takes a review against Jayasuriya. An lbw shout has not be entertained by the umpire. Let's see...
Back of a length ball, Mathews flat-bats it to long on for a run.
Another well-directed short ball, right towards the rib cage of Prabath. He is forced to hop and fend it off. Only 4 from the over.
Full ball outside off, Prabath drives it off the outer half of the bat behind backward point. A couple taken.
Good bowling from Rabada! Attacks Jayasuriya with a sharp short ball. He hops and blocks it.
Full ball tailing in, patted back towards the bowler.
Pitched up ball outside off, Jayasuriya strokes it through covers to come back for a couple.
Short of a length ball around off, Prabath hops and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Fullish ball, angling in, helped to the leg side for a run.
The debutant, Prabath Jayasuriya comes out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Once again, Phehlukwayo bowls the knuckle ball on a fullish length. Lakmal falls over a bit and is early into his flick shot. Ends up getting beaten. The ball then kisses his back pad and deflects onto the stumps. Can South Africa bowl out Sri Lanka inside 50 overs?
Short of a length ball, tucked through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Shortish ball, pulled towards short mid-wicket.

Not out! Yes, it is sliding down leg. Good review from Lakmal. Phehlukwayo bowls a knuckle ball on a fuller length around off and gets it to cut in. Lakmal tries to play it defensively to the leg side but misses to get struck on the pads. Phehlukwayo rises up in an appeal and the umpire obliges. Lakmal has a chat with Mathews and takes the DRS. The replays roll in. There is nothing on the Snicko. The Hawk Eye now shows that ball is missing the leg stump by an inch.
Lakmal has been trapped in front of the stumps but after a discussion with his skipper, he signals for the 'T.' Is it going down leg?
Andile Phehlukwayo to bowl his final spell.
Around the hips this time, tucked to fine leg for a single.
Wide! The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. Wide signalled by the umpire.

FOUR! Shot! Shortish ball, sits up nicely for Lakmal. He swivels across and pulls it over the mid-wicket region to pick up his first boundary. Sri Lanka will be aiming to push beyond the 260-run mark.
Mathews makes use of the depth of the crease to turn this back of a length ball through mid-wicket. A run taken.
Angling into the pads as Suranga clips it through mid-wicket for a run and gets off the mark.
Fullish ball around off, drilled to the mid off fielder.
Wide! Down the leg side, Lakmal tries to flick but misses.
Suranga Lakmal is the new man in.

OUT! The bowling change immediately works for the Proteas! Sri Lanka are losing the plot as wickets are falling in a cluster for them. Fuller length ball outside off, in the slot for Dananjaya. He goes for a booming drive but ends up slicing it towards extra cover. David Miller stationed there leaps and takes a sharp catch. Markram in the background has a big smile on his face. The hosts are in danger of getting bowled out before the full quota of overs.
Rabada comes back for his final spell.

Shorter in length, forced away with the spin to sweeper cover. A run taken. End of a frugal spell from Shamsi. He finishes with figures of - 10-0-43-0. A job well done considering he went for 21 in his first two overs.
Waits for this one to turn into him and tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up generously outside off, Dananjaya mistimes his drive through cover-point. A run taken.
Well bowled! Slips in the googly, Akila tries to drive it but without picking it. Gets beaten and is hit on the pads.
Full toss this time, whipped away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, defended solidly off the front foot.
Angelo shuffles across a touch and helps it around the corner for a single. 10 from this over.
Right in the blockhole around off, Mathews jams it out through mid-wicket. Some aggressive running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for a couple.
Uppish but safe! Length ball on middle and leg, Dananjaya mistimes his tuck towards mid-wicket where there is no fielder. A single is the result.
Similar length ball around off, worked away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length outside off, guided past point to change strike.
FOUR! Good shot selection! Fuller in length around off, Dananjaya chips it over the mid off fielder. There is no protection in the deep and a boundary results.
Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot. Only a run from the over, Shamsi has been on the money in his second spell.
Dananjaya tries to loft the fuller delivery but miscues it over mid off. A run taken.
Four dots in a row! Similar delivery, Akila fails to find the gap as he again chops it to point.
Spinning away from around off as it is cut away towards point.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Leans ahead and eases this one to the covers.
FOUR! Streaky boundary! Length ball outside off, Mathews tries to force it through the line but gets an outside edge through the vacant slip region. 200 up for Sri Lanka.
Akila Dananjaya comes out to bat.

OUT! Thisara Perera fails to make an impact with the bat in this game! Ngidi is having a gala time with the ball as he picks up a 3-fer. He steams in and bowls an effort ball. It shoots off the deck as it keeps climbing onto the southpaw. He goes for the pull but fails to get on top of the bounce. Ends up getting a top edge that skies behind. De Kock keeps a eye on the helmet behind him and evades it. Has his eyes glued on the ball and takes the catch nicely. South Africa will be happy to see the back of Perera as he can prove to be really dangerous.
Back of a length outside off, chopped away to the man at point.
Another mix-up but no harm done! Perera tries to clip this one but the ball brushes his pads and rolls to the leg side. Perera wants a run but he is again sent back by the skipper.
Full ball outside off, drilled to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length ball, pushed off the back foot to the cover region.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.

A miscommunication but safe eventually! Down the leg side, Angelo helps it towards the man at 45. Mathews sets off initially but realizes that there is no run in it. Perera is halfway down the track and is sent back. The throw from the fielder is a wayward one though which allows Thisara to get back home comfortably. A better throw might have had him wanting.
Beaten! The straighter one outside off, skids after pitching. Mathews tries to cut it away but misses.
The length is shorter on this one as Mathews has ample time to rock back and turn it through the vacant square leg region. Two runs taken.
Spinning into Mathews who turns it towards mid-wicket.
Full ball outside off, jammed to the cover region.
Time for Powerplay 3! Maximum of five fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of innings.
Back of a length around off, Mathews punches it towards the off side. The fielder from extra cover gets across to his left to stop it but fails as the ball goes towards mid off. A run taken.
Full delivery, tailing in nicely from around off. Perera clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
A slower short ball on middle and leg, Mathews is early into his pull shot and hence, mistimes it towards square leg. A run taken.
Length ball well outside off, forced to Mulder at sweeper cover to rotate strike.
Short ball on off, pulled away hard towards deep mid-wicket. Duminy in the deep does well to slide to his right and stop it. A couple taken.
FOUR! Hammered! Back of a length and some width on offer. Perera pounces on it and slaps it through covers. Mulder in the deep runs to his right, dives but fails to stop it. A boundary results.
Lungi Ngidi is back on.
Lunges to a full ball outside off and pushes it with the turn to covers. It's in the gap and they cross.
On the pads and it has been flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Nicely flighted and full on off, Mathews pushes it back but Shamsi stops it with a dive to his right.
Short and wide outside off, Perera gets back and slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Full floated on off, knocked down to long on for one.
Tossed up ball outside off, Thisara leans forward and gently pushes it wide of backward point for a run.
Good length ball outside off, angling in, Mathews defends it back to end the over.
Goes short this time and Thisara easily pulls it down towards long leg for one.
FOUR! Bang! Back of a length ball around off, Phehlukwayo offers width and Thisara rocks back to capitalize. Gives it a good whack and smashes it through point for a boundary.
Drifting down the leg side, Mathews eases it through backward square leg and picks up a run.
On a length and outside off, Mathews mishits it back towards the bowler.
Back of a length ball around middle, it's been worked behind square leg for a run.
Phehlukwayo returns.
At a quicker pace and on a fullish length outside off, Angelo drags it towards mid on. 2 from the over, another tidy one from Shamsi.
Turns this one around the corner with the spin, wants a run but there is none on offer.
Leans ahead and defends it solidly off the front foot.
Tossed up ball, tapped off the front foot towards mid on.

In the air... but safe! Tossed up ball on middle, Perera tries to go downtown but mistimes it, getting more height on it rather than elevation. Rabada from long on runs in but it falls well short of him. One run added to the total.
Fullish ball around off, eased down to long on for a single.
Short and room on offer, slapped to deep point for a single.
Full ball straying on the pads, tickled down to fine leg for a single.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.

36th ODI fifty for Mathews, his first in 2018! The Sri Lankan skipper will breathe a sigh of relief. Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a run. He gets a good round of applause from his teammates. Hasn't been a free-flowing knock but it has been a vital one. Needs to finish well now.
Pitched up ball around off, driven towards Mulder who got a hand to it to deflect it towards mid off.
Back of a length around off, punched on the up towards mid off.
Another one that turns away appreciably to beat Thisara once again. Only 1 from the over.
Ripper! Turns away sharply from middle to go past the hanging bat of Perera.
Leans ahead to this one and keeps it out watchfully.
Ooh! That stayed low. On a shorter length outside off, doesn't take off at all. Thisara goes for a cut but is foxed by it.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
An appeal falls on deaf ears! Spinning in sharply from off to struck Mathews on the pads. It was going down leg perhaps.
Thisara Perera walks out to bat.

OUT! A definite edge there! Judicious use of the review from South Africa. Length ball down the leg side, Jayasuriya moves inside the line to clip it but the ball goes off something behind to de Kock who takes it and appeals. The umpire is not convinced. Mulder is very confident and so is Faf du Plessis. The skipper consults with the keeper and signals for the review. Time for the replays. Well, there is a definite spike on the Snicko as the ball goes past the bat which means there is an inside edge. The ball then brushed the thigh pad to go into the mitts of Quinton. The on-field call is overturned. Wicket at the right time for the visitors.
Review time! South Africa are absolutely confident that they have strangled Jayasuriya down the leg side. Faf goes for the review. Is there an edge?
Full ball around off, Shehan absolutely smashes it but picks out the mid off fielder.

Short ball but it is pretty high. Jayasuriya shapes for the ramp shot but realizes that it will be futile to attempt it. One bouncer signaled for the over. Shehan rising up on his toes didn't help his cause.
Mathews taps the good length ball towards cover-point for a quick run.
Length ball on off, Angelo works it with the angle to short mid-wicket.

FOUR! Confidently played! Moves onto 47 with that. Mulder rolls his fingers on this one and bowls a short ball on middle and leg. Mathews gets on top of the bounce and pulls it with aplomb through backward square leg.
Well bowled! Slower through the air around off, turning away. Shehan is not quite to the pitch of it as he pushes it uppishly towards the cover region.
Full loopy ball outside off, eased down to long off for an easy single.
Almost dragged this back! Straighter one on a shorter length outside off, Jayasuriya tries to slap it away but gets a bottom edge between his legs. A run taken.
Hangs back and plays this one with the spin to the point region.
Jayasuriya kneels and sweeps this one from outside off to fine leg. Rabada slides to his left to cut it off. A couple taken.
Tosses this one nicely outside off, luring Jayasuriya to play an expansive shot. He resits the temptation and lets it be.
Mulder once again strays on the pads, Shehan turns it past square leg for a single.
Nice shot! A bouncer which comes at a good height to Jayasuriya. He pulls it all along the ground towards deep mid-wicket. Duminy runs to his right and stops a couple for his side.
Back of a length outside off, Shehan hangs back and defends it stoutly to the off side.
On a length on middle and off, Jayasuriya helps it to the short mid-wicket fielder.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Length ball on the hips, Shehan works it to deep square leg for a single.
Drinks time! Meanwhile, Willem Mulder returns for a bowl.
Floated ball outside off, Jayasuriya milks it down to long off for a single. A frugal over from Shamsi at the start of his second spell, only 2 from it.
A bit wider outside off, driven past the bowler down to long off for a run. 150 up for Sri Lanka.
Four dots in a row! Slower through the air, Mathews taps it off the front foot towards mid-wicket.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery as Angelo helps it to the same fielder.
Spinning down the leg side, helped to the man at 45.
Fullish ball around leg stump, tucked to mid-wicket.
Tabraiz Shamsi returns with a change of ends.
Full ball on the pads, turned to the leg side for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Safe! Mathews was not obstructing the field there. A mix-up but no damage done eventually. Mathews tucks the length ball towards mid-wicket and sets off. However, he is sent back by his partner as Faf dives to his right to stop it inside the ring. Mathews has his bat in his left hand and turns back. He then takes the bat in his right hand and dives in to make his crease as the shy from du Plessis misses the stumps at the striker's end. The South African skipper appeals for obstruction as the umpires get together to discuss it. They go upstairs and give the soft signal as not out. The third umpire has a look at a couple of replays and decides that the Sri Lankan skipper was not coming in the way of the throw. If there was a direct hit though, it would have been touch and go.
Faf du Plessis has appealed against Mathews for obstructing the field. The soft signal is not out though.

FOUR! Lucky Mathews! Length ball outside off, Mathews is early into the shot but still manages to chip it from the middle of the bat. It flies just past the left side of the bowler and beats mid off to find the ropes.
Jayasuriya comes down the track and flicks this one through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Good length ball on middle and leg, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Rabada returns.
Duminy bowls one in the blockhole, Shehan jams it out off the inner half of the bat.
There is a bit of drizzle in the air.
Straight in line and full in length, worked through square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Cheeky! Jayasuriya was trying to manufacture a shot and he manages to do so. Gets a bit of room outside off and guides it at the last moment past first slip to pick up a boundary.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Slower through the air, Jayasuriya comes ahead and defends it with authority.
It has gone quite dark here. The artificial lights have started to take effect.
Full floated ball outside off, driven hard to extra cover.
On a length outside off, defended solidly off the back foot.
FOUR! Intelligent batting from Mathews! Knows the third man fielder is pretty square and intentionally opens the face of his bat to a back of a length ball to find the fence.
This one takes off from a back of a length. Angelo does well to ride the bounce and stonewall it.
Shorter in length outside off, punched off the back foot to extra cover.
Short ball, sits up nicely for Angelo. He pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Shehan comes down the track and turns this one from his pads around the corner. A run taken.
Well bowled! Sliding across with the arm, Mathews tries to drive it through the line but gets beaten. Tidy over from Duminy, only 2 from it.
Short ball outside off, forced off the back foot to sweeper cover for a run.
Drifting in towards Shehan who is not quite to the pitch of it and gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg.
Smart work from Miller! Moves to his left swiftly and dives to stop the crisp drive from Jayasuriya.
Slower through the air outside off, driven to the cover fielder.
Tossed up delivery, milked down to long off for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Mathews smartly opens the face of his bat to steer it behind point. A run taken.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Well played! Short ball going down leg, Mathews rolls his wrists on it to pull it behind square leg. The fielder from fine leg moves to his left to stop a boundary. Two runs taken.
On a length in line of the stumps, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shehan Jayasuriya comes out to bat.

OUT! Chopped on! A disappointing end to a good knock from Dickwella. Phehlukwayo bowls a length ball in the avenue of apprehension and it stays a touch low. Dickwella with zero footwork tries to slap it square of the wicket on the off side but gets an inside edge that crashes into the stumps. The 67-run stand has been broken. South Africa will be aiming to chip away at the wickets regularly from hereon.
Back of a length ball close to the off stump, Dickwella pushes at it but gets a bottom edge. The ball rolls beside the pitch on the off side and Niroshan wants a run but he is sent back.

On a flatter trajectory and shorter in length, Mathews hangs back and works it through square leg. The fielder in the deep has a lot of ground to cover and by the time he cuts it off, a couple results.
The fullish ball allows Dickwella to get underneath it as he slog sweeps it to the deep square leg fielder for a single.
Floated delivery on off, Mathews helps it around the corner to rotate strike.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Turns the tossed up ball to the leg side for a single.
Brilliant fielding! Shorter in length, Dickwella cuts it with the spin towards covers. Faf dives to his right and saves certain runs for his side.
Short of a length outside off, eased off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Good length ball, angling across the southpaw who attempts to cut it square on the off side but misses.
Anything on the pads and Dickwella will score all day. Whips this one over mid-wicket to come back for a couple.
Wide! Short ball but down the leg side, Niroshan goes for the hook but misses.

Leg bye! Phehlukwayo rolls his fingers on this one but slips it down the leg side. Angelo tries to turn it around the corner but the ball brushes his thigh pad and goes on the bounce towards de Kock who fails to stop it cleanly. A run taken.
Another pitched up ball in the same area, driven crisply towards mid off.
Full ball outside off, defended off the front foot to covers.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes back for a bowl.
Duminy tosses this one up on leg stump, aiming to bring the short mid on fielder into play. Mathews uses his feet and drags his heave past the right side of the fielder. A run taken.

Dickwella tries to go inside out but doesn't have the space to work it. Ends up chipping it much straighter than he intended. The fielder from long off runs to his right and keeps the batsmen down to a run.
Leans ahead to the very full ball to ease it to covers.
Off spinner on off stump, knocked down to long on to rotate strike.
Dickwella kneels and sweeps the fullish ball from outside off behind square leg. A run taken.
The batsman has driven it towards mid off.

Confusion but no damage done! Tossed up outside off, driven towards sweeper cover for a single. Dickwella sets off for another run as he is ball-watching. Mathews sends him back. He loses his balance a bit but gets back home safely.

FOUR! Nicely done! The straighter one from Shamsi. Dickwella crouches and sweeps it behind square leg. The fielder in the deep runs to his left, dives but the ball races across to the fence. That brings up the 50-run stand between the duo. Good going.
Good running! Mathews taps this one to covers and scurries across to the other end.
Fullish loopy ball around off, driven to the right side of the bowler who stops it.
Similar delivery, this time Niroshan cuts it nicely to deep cover for a single.
On a flatter trajectory around off, Dickwella rocks back in order to cut it away with the spin but misses.
Full ball outside off, Angelo jams it back to the bowler.
Leans ahead and taps this one with the spin to short mid-wicket.
Dickwella kneels and nails the sweep towards deep square leg. A run taken.
Confused everyone there! Mathews tries to work the tossed up ball towards mid on but gets a leading edge towards mid off. A run taken.
Another one down the leg side, Niroshan helps it to the man at 45 to rotate strike. 100 up for Sri Lanka and it is met with a cheer from the crowd.
Low full toss down the leg side, Dickwella fails to capitalize on it as he sweeps it towards short fine leg where Amla dives to his left to stop it.
Mathews tries to drop and run by tapping the tossed up ball towards mid-wicket but the fielder is quick to attack it. 14 from the over.
Tossed up outside off, eased to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! 6th ODI fifty for Niroshan Dickwella! It has been a gutsy knock from the southpaw and he will be eyeing a big one. Another short ball, quicker in pace around off. Dickwella just uses the pace on it and guides it to the vacant third man region for a boundary. He raises his bat and gets the acknowledgement from the crowd. 13 from Shamsi's first four deliveries.
FOUR! Well played! Dickwella moves onto 49 with that. Shamsi errs in length again. Bowls it short, spinning away. Dickwella dabs it past short third man to pick up another boundary.
Leans ahead to the floated ball and helps it to the leg side for a run.
FOUR! Poor delivery and gets the punishment. Bad start from Shamsi. Down the leg side, Mathews clips it past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Tabraiz Shamsi comes into the attack. He was the Man of the Match in the last game with his 4-wicket haul.
Duminy drags his length back, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
Straighter in line and slower in pace, eased back to the bowler.
Good fielding from Duminy off his own bowling. Fuller in length, driven to the right of the bowler who dived full length to deny a run to the batsman.
This time he connects with the sweep to get it towards deep square leg. A run taken.
Wide! Another one down the leg side, Niroshan goes for the sweep but this time he misses.
Tossed up ball, defended solidly off the front foot.

FOUR! Not convincing but effective! Drifting towards the leg stump, Dickwella kneels and goes for the sweep but seems to have gloved it past the keeper. The ball rolls across to the fine leg fence. Well, the replay shows that it came off the inner half of the bat.
An overpitched delivery. Mathews leans ahead to stroke it to wide mid off. A maiden for Ngidi.
He continues to hit the same length and Mathews is solid as a rock.

Ngidi continues to hit the deck hard and bowls a back of a length ball around off, Mathews hops and stonewalls it. Perhaps time for Ngidi to bowl a yorker or pitch the ball up to catch the batsman off guard.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Mathews is aware where his off stump is and makes an assured leave.
Short of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to the cover region.
Good length ball in line of the stumps, Mathews hangs back and blocks it stoutly.
Beauty! Quicker in pace and on a flatter trajectory. Pitches around middle and off and turns away sharply to go past the forward defense of Dickwella. 3 from Duminy's first over.
Slower through the air around leg stump, Dickwella tries to defend it but is not to the pitch of it. A leading edge results but it falls down safely in the cover region.
Fuller in length, Angelo whips it past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Generously tossed up around off, Mathews puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Another full toss, Dickwella works it through wide mid on for a run.
Begins with a low full toss on off, knocked down to long on for a single.
Time for spin for the first time in this innings. JP Duminy is introduced into the attack. Meanwhile, there are dark clouds hovering around in the backdrop. Let's hope the rain stays away.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Dickwella is cramped for room as he gets hit on the thigh pad.
Sensible stuff from Mathews as he keeps the scoreboard ticking. Taps the fullish ball past mid on to change strike.
In the channel outside off, Mathews leaves it.
Wide! Hurled way outside off, Angelo lets it go.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a length on middle and off, blocked watchfully.

FOUR! Dickwella attacks Rabada straightaway in his new spell and puts him under pressure. Fuller length ball, coming in with the natural around the wicket angle. Dickwella makes room and hits it over mid on to find the ropes.
Kagiso Rabada is back on.
Mulder bends his back and bowls a surprise bouncer. Mathews sways away from the line to evade it.
Good judgement! On a length around the hips, Mathews tucks it nicely around the corner. Calls for a couple straightaway and completes it with ease.
Mulder drags his length back around the off stump channel. Mathews makes use of the depth of the crease to punch it towards mid off.
Slightly overpitched around off, driven on the up towards mid off.
On a length on middle, defended off the back foot with a straight bat.
On a length around off, Dickwella shuffles across and forces it over cover-point for a single. An example of how good his hand-eye coordination is.
Short of a length on off, Mathews turns it nicely through mid-wicket and takes a couple. 8 from this over, a good one for Sri Lanka.
Overpitched outside off, driven to covers.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side, Angelo tries to flick but only connects with thin air.

FOUR! Shot! A juicy half-volley on off, Mathews leans ahead and strokes it down the ground for an exquisite boundary at long off. With that, he becomes the 4th Sri Lankan captain to score 3000 ODI runs. A good achievement for him.

That's a jaffa! He does have an issue outside his off stump. In the last game, he fell prey to that channel. This one is a little closer to the off stump and angles in. Mathews feels for it but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Pitched up ball, driven back towards the bowler.
On a length on off, Dickwella tries to force it through the line but gets it off the inner half through square leg. A run taken.

Slower ball down the leg side, Niroshan tries to flick it away but because of the lack of pace on it, he mistimes it towards fine leg. A run taken, the only run in this over. 7 runs have come off the last 4 overs, good pressure being applied by the South Africans.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Niroshan hops and tucks it towards mid-wicket. He has a wry smile on his face, good to see that he is fine.

Dickwella is in a lot of discomfort. He is down on the ground and straightaway calls for the physio. Mathews walks across to him to check on him. Blows on the rib cage are always painful. Hopefully, he will be alright.

Ouch! That will hurt. Short ball, angling sharply into Dickwella. He hops and tries to keep it out but the ball brushes his gloves and thuds into his rib cage. He immediately falls flat on the ground and is in deep pain.
Shortish ball on middle and leg, Dickwella arches back, drops his wrists and deals with it nicely.
Fullish ball in line of the stumps, pushed back towards the bowler.
Short of a length ball on off, turned off the back foot to mid-wicket.
On a good length, kept out watchfully. A wicket and a run from the over.
The Sri Lanka skipper, Angelo Mathews strides out to bat.

OUT! Phehlukwayo strikes! Perera was trying hard to break free as a lot of shots he hit went straight to the fielders. Eventually he perishes. Shortish ball on middle and off, angling away with extra bounce. It is climbing up on Perera but he still goes for a pull from an uncomfortable position. Ends up mistiming it towards wide mid on. Ngidi, who is a terrific athlete, backpedals and moves to his left, leaps and takes a well-judged catch. The promising 43-run stand comes to an end.
Fullish ball on middle and off, eased off the front foot to covers.
On a length outside off, Niroshan guides it to third man for a single.
Full ball attacking the stumps, driven crisply to mid off.
A play and a miss! Full ball, angling across. Dickwella plays away from the body and gets beaten.

A huge appeal for an LBW, turned down! Length ball around leg stump, angling in. Perera goes for the flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Mulder is pleading to the umpire to get the decision in his favour but he stays put. Faf feels that it pitched outside leg and indicates that to his bowler. The skipper is right as the replay shows the ball pitched just outside leg.
On a length outside off, run down to third man for a single.
Pitched up ball around off, eased to mid off for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.

Some confusion but no harm done! Full ball on middle and leg, Perera taps it towards short mid-wicket. The short mid-wicket fielder fumbles a touch and that interests Perera. But, he is sent back by his partner.
Length ball down the leg side, Dickwella helps it to fine leg to rotate strike.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Four fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Fullish ball, leaving Perera. He plants his front foot across to let it go.
Short of a length around off, Perera forces it through the line but finds the cover-point fielder.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shortish ball and some room on offer, Perera cuts it towards point.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Dickwella flicks it towards the square leg fielder who dives to his left but doesn't stop it cleanly. A run taken.
Perera works the length delivery through mid-wicket for a run.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes on for a bowl.

FOUR! Free runs are on offer! Length ball down the leg side, Dickwella gets inside the line and turns it through backward square leg to pick up another boundary. 50 up for Sri Lanka, decent going after they lost a couple of early wickets.
Back of a length on off, angling across Niroshan. He chops it to the man at backward point.
Well bowled! On a length in line of the stumps, some nibble in the air. Perera brings his bat down tentatively and gets it off the inner half past mid-wicket. A run taken.
Good shot but not in the gap. Pitched up ball outside off, Kusal drills it towards Amla at extra cover who is standing a bit up.
On a length on middle, Perera makes use of the depth of the crease and blocks it with authority.
Starts off with a full ball on middle and leg, Dickwella works it towards wide mid on for a single.
Willem Mulder comes into the attack.
Pitched up ball on the pads, eased off the front foot to mid on.
Back of a length ball, stump-to-stump line, Perera hangs back and stonewalls it.
Leg Bye! Good length ball on middle and leg, Dickwella tries to play it across but the ball brushes his pads and rolls towards square leg. The batsmen pinch a run.

A bit uppish but safe! In the corridor of uncertainty, sticks a bit on the surface. Dickwella shapes to play the cover drive but checks his shot at the last moment. The ball goes past the left side of the short cover fielder who is a touch square.
Straying on the hips this time, tucked around the corner for a single.
Fractionally overpitched around off, Perera absolutely clobbers it but finds the man at wide mid off. A meter either side of him and that would have been a boundary.
On a length outside off, takes off after landing. Niroshan does well to defend it towards point. A maiden for Rabada, good over.
Fuller length ball on middle, kept out watchfully beside the pitch on the leg side.
Short of a length on off, Dickwella hops and taps it with an angled bat towards point. The bounce has been true on this surface.
Dickwella makes a lot of room this time and Rabada follows him. Dickwella can only block it.
Excellent delivery from Rabada! He bowls a good length ball in the avenue of apprehension. After pitching, the ball straightens a touch to square Dickwella up and goes past his hanging bat.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Niroshan gets behind it and pushes it to covers.
Pitched up ball around off, Niroshan eases it towards deepish mid off for a run and will retain strike.
Good length ball around off, drilled but straight to the cover fielder.
Short of a length ball aimed at the body, dealt nicely by Dickwella.

FOUR! A gift and duly accepted! Time and again, Ngidi has done the mistake of bowling down the leg side. Dickwella whips it through the mid-wicket region to find the fence once again. Fourth boundary for him.
Fractionally overpitched around off, driven crisply towards mid off.
Perera taps the length ball towards extra cover for a quick run.
On a length around off, kept out to the off side. Though the hosts have lost a couple of wickets, the runs continue to flow for them. 10 from this one.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Innovation has worked for the wicket-keeper batsman. Good length ball, swerving in. Niroshan again makes some space for himself and ramps it over the wide gully fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Dickwella knows only one way to play - attack. Fuller length ball, angling in from around off. Dickwella makes room and drills it through covers for a rocketing boundary.
Two gullies in place now.
Shortish ball, attacking the body of Niroshan. He hops and fends it off expertly.
Back of a length ball on middle, Niroshan clips it uppishly past the diving short mid-wicket fielder for a couple.
Very full ball attacking the stumps, Dickwella dead-bats it.
This is the way Perera plays. Full ball outside off, Perera lofts it over covers but doesn't get it off the meat of the bat. A couple of runs. 9 from the over.
Wide! This time Lungi doesn't get away with it. Length ball down the leg side, Kusal fails to connect bat to ball. The umpire stretches his arms.
FOUR! Ngidi bowled the same ball to Tharanga earlier and this time again he pays the price. Full ball on the pads, Perera clips it through square leg and the ball races to the fence.
Ngidi has got away with that one. Short ball outside leg stump, angling in a bit. Perera ducks under it. However, the umpire doesn't signal a wide. I reckon he got it wrong there.
Good running! Niroshan taps the fullish ball with soft hands towards extra cover and steals a run.
Perera works it down the leg side. They pick up a single. He is off the mark.
Perera survives the hat-trick ball! Good length ball on off, Perera hangs back and dead-bats it.

FOUR! Double bluff from Rabada but Dickwella has got the better of him. He brought a short leg into position but bowls a fullish ball on off. Niroshan lifts it over mid off to find the ropes. Good contest going on between bat and ball.
Short ball around middle and leg, climbing on Dickwella. He rides the bounce and defends it towards the vacant short leg region.
Short of a length outside off, played with an angled bat towards point.
Good length ball in line of the stumps, Dickwella stonewalls it.
Back of a length ball, answered with a straight bat from the comfort of the crease.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Kusal Perera is the new man in. He was the hero in the previous match. His side is in trouble and he needs to play a responsible knock yet again.

OUT! Ngidi is on a roll, two wickets in two balls! Just like the previous game, the Sri Lankans have been found wanting in the initial phase. He bowls a ball in the tight off stump corridor and gets it to shape in substantially. Mendis shuffles across a touch but falls over a bit in an attempt to flick it. Ends up missing it altogether and is struck in front. The visitors go up in unison and up goes the umpire's finger. Kusal keeps walking and doesn't consult his partner for the review. The replay shows that he was a dead duck. So after being hit for a couple of boundaries, Ngidi has bounced back with aplomb. He will be on a hat-trick in the next over.
Kusal Mendis comes out to bat.

OUT! Ngidi draws first blood! A rather poor shot to gift his wicket away, not what you expect from a batsman who has loads of experience in ODIs. Good length ball around off, shaping away from Tharanga. He doesn't move his feet and throws his bat at it, away from the body. The result is a faint under edge and de Kock behind the stumps is as safe as houses. Jubilation for South Africa.
FOUR! Crisp! Fuller length ball around off, Tharanga leans ahead and strokes it beautifully through extra cover to pick up his second boundary.
Shaping away from Upul who leaves it alone.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Full ball on the pads, Tharanga flicks it over square leg to find the fence. The first boundary of the innings.

That's a peach! We saw a lot of occasions in the previous game where the balls took off from the pitch. Though this time the surface looks a lot drier, still there is some fizz in it. Back of a length ball on middle and off, shoots off with extra bounce. Tharanga feels for it and is beaten all ends up.
Wide! Just like Rabada, Ngidi is off the radar first up. Delivers a short and wide delivery to which Tharanga shoulders his arms.
Lungi Ngidi to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.

Misfield, something that won't please Faf at all. On a length, swinging in a touch. Dickwella goes at it with hard hands but gets it off the inner half towards square leg. Mulder there makes a mess of it and concedes a couple. Schoolboy error from him. 4 from the first over.
Back of a length ball on off, Tharanga hops and answers it with a straight bat.
Good length ball in the tight off stump corridor, seaming away after landing. The veteran plants his front foot across and lets it go.
Tharanga is away! Shortish ball and there is room on offer, Upul cuts it uppishly behind backward point for a single.
Similar length ball shaping away from Tharanga who doesn't bother to flirt with it.
On a length, angling across Upul. It pitches and then skids off the deck. Upul does well to adjust in his crease and block it towards covers.
Wide! Starts off with a loosener. It is short and wide outside off, Tharanga leaves it alone.

We are set to get rolling. The umpires and the players make their way to the middle. Niroshan Dickwella and Upul Tharanga are the openers for Sri Lanka. Kagiso Rabada to bowl with the first new ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...

South Africa skipper, Faf du Plessis says that they are happy to bowl first. States that there is still a bit of green tinge on the surface but there are brown patches as well. Mentions that there was a good bounce on this track and they have the bowlers who can utilize that. Reckons that they need to bowl better in the middle overs. Informs that they are playing with the same personnel.

Sri Lanka skipper, Angelo Mathews says that they will bat first. Mentions that the first 8-10 overs are crucial. States that they want to play positive cricket. Informs there are two changes - Two youngsters make their debut. Kasun Rajitha comes in place of the injured Lahiru Kumara and Lakshan Sandakan makes way for Prabath Jayasuriya.
TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to bat again.

Pitch report - Kepler Wessels says that the same surface is being used in this game as well. Adds that it has dried out and the greenness has reduced. Feels that the track will be slower and lower and the spinners will come into play more. Mentions that the temptation will be to field first as the teams chasing have a better record but he opines that the captain winning the toss should bat first and aim to score something around 275.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the 2nd ODI between Sri Lanka and South Africa in Dambulla. After a bland performance in the first game, the hosts will be aiming to get their act together. They do have talented players in their ranks and the Lankan skipper, Angelo Mathews needs to guide them on the right path. South Africa, on the other hand, are an explosive limited-overs side. They are really balanced which makes them a force to reckon with. The momentum is on their side and the visitors need to cash on it but it won't be an easy task against the hosts who will be eyeing a revenge. Pitch report and toss will come up in a while...
